pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Infracost shows cloud cost estimates for Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, and AWS CDK before changes are deployed, in the terminal, in editors, and in pull requests.
Default operation (`infracost breakdown`) requires an Infracost Cloud Pricing API key (free registration via `infracost auth login`); a self-hosted Cloud Pricing API is available as a separate upstream project for fully offline use.
This package installs the statically linked binaries published in upstream releases.
